# OC Bot Shows

> LED robot performers for events in Orange County, California and the surrounding areas. The illuminated robots dance, interact with guests and pose for photos.

## Services
- 45-minute LED robot show: 30 minutes of dancing and 15 minutes of photos
- Events: weddings, quinceañeras, sweet 16s, corporate events, birthdays, concerts and all other types of events
- Service area: Orange County, California and surrounding areas

## Pricing
- Show, Monday to Thursday: $450
- Show, Friday to Sunday: $499
- Add-ons: CO2 cannon $100, 50 balloons $25, 25 LED noodles $25, money shooter $25, extra robot $300 (each)

## Book or ask a question
- Website with booking calendar: https://ocbotshows.com/
- Email: ocbotshows@gmail.com
- Text or call: 949-395-0250
- Requests are answered within 24 hours
